items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I elected to go to NYU to take a course with Rudolph Schramm in the Schilinger system of music

ctx.x: Just so I can clear up, this information did not have … you went to New York University Graduate School of Music from '46 to '47.

Yeah. Well when I came out of the Navy, I found that I had, was entitled to post graduate work to take further schooling and I elected to go to NYU to take a course with Rudolph Schramm in the Schilinger system of music and that's what that was about.
